versions.changelog: Patched to support OpenClaw weekly Telegram delivery

Initial release of "garden-assistance" skill for managing raised-bed gardens.

- Supports user profile setup, including local climate, bed size, and automatic climate configuration.
- Provides commands for garden status, planted crops, watering schedules, sowing recommendations, reminders, and harvest tracking.
- Enables management of crop entries, reminders, harvest logs, and knowledge base crops with clear CRUD commands.
- Integrates Open-Meteo for weekly forecasts and seasonal garden planning.
- Offers intent map to translate common user requests into deterministic commands for ease of use.
